In very basic education you're taught to believe, but using any sort of higher level science you can trivially prove the earth is spherical. The most basic thing is that if the earth was flat the day-night cycle would be entirely different. In particular Eratosthenes' method that was used to measure the diameter of the earth (in the third century BC!) would not work. The majority of the day would have the cast shadow identical. This is not what happens as you could verify yourself.

Another not so simple idea would be to consider the rotational velocity of the earth. In a flat earth the rotational velocity would be identical throughout. This means a rocket launched from an equatorial trajectory would have an identical orbit relative velocity to one launched off the equator. This can be 'trivially' proven to be false.
